summary.content:
Today's selection covers 95 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 63 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Slack is launching collaborative vibe-coding channels
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: No-Filter 'Kriminal' AI Platform Raises Cybercrime Concerns
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, Dark Reading, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 51 articles published in the last 24 hours
